how.title: How it works
how.earn: Earning. Your clock starts when your wallet reaches the amount and restarts if it drops below. Staked and locked $FLYAI counts as held.
how.claim: Claiming. Claim any badges you've earned in one transaction. You only pay the gas, on Robinhood Chain.
how.keep: Keeping. A claimed badge stays even if you sell later. Badges can only be removed for a mistake or abuse.
